title: Output of python -m spq.signal --contract 2 for a perpetual-futures strategy (one line on stdout, exit code 0)
description: Version 2 of the signal output. The version-1 output (signal-output.schema.json) is unchanged and is still what a spot strategy prints. The weights are TARGETS in fractions of account equity, not orders: sizing, margin, liquidation distance and every risk limit belong to the engine and the signer.

as_of.description: bar-open time (UTC) of the last closed bar the decision is based on; no input dated after it was used

weights.description: one entry per symbol of META['universe']: signed notional / account equity, negative = short. A perpetual is within +/- max_leverage, a spot leg ('<SYMBOL>.SPOT') within [0, 1], and the absolute values sum to at most max_gross_exposure (checked by the runner before printing)

max_leverage.description: META['max_leverage'], part of the hashed file

max_gross_exposure.description: META['max_gross_exposure'], part of the hashed file
